Not exercised in this visual correction: Safari/Firefox/physical authenticators; permission-denied, unsupported-browser and server-error visual flows; deletion confirmation and MFA settings outside this component. Security API rejection and real signed multi-passkey authentication covered separately by existing TC-SEC-004.
